name: Gainey Thursday
schedule: Every Thursday, 5:30 am, year-round, from the southeast corner of Scottsdale Road and Doubletree Ranch Road (Gainey Village). Rain usually cancels it.

start_location.name: Gainey Village, Scottsdale Rd and Doubletree Ranch Rd (southeast corner)

pace: Advanced and hilly, in the club's own rating
visitor_notes: The Strava club is invite-only to keep spam out; request to join to see the route and any changes. Starts in the dark much of the year, so bring lights. If it's raining, it's likely cancelled.
description: Scottsdale's big Thursday-morning road ride, rolling out of Gainey Village before sunrise. The club rates it advanced and hilly. The long-standing route runs about 29 miles with roughly 1,100 feet of climbing. Same corner as the club's Saturday ride.
evidence: Scottsdale Cycling's Strava event page lists the next ride for Thu Oct 1, 2026 at 5:30 am from 8977 N Scottsdale Rd, rated Advanced / Hilly (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The event page shows the next date without a login; the club's event list needs one.

name: The Saturday Ride (Fuss Buss)
schedule: Every Saturday, 5:30 am, from the same Gainey Village corner as the Thursday ride. Rain usually cancels it.

start_location.name: Gainey Village, Scottsdale Rd and Doubletree Ranch Rd

pace: Intermediate and rolling, in the club's own rating
visitor_notes: Request to join the Strava club to see the route and any changes. Early start, so bring lights in the darker months. If it's raining, it's likely cancelled.
description: Scottsdale Cycling's Saturday road ride, one step easier than Gainey Thursday: the club rates it intermediate and rolling. Same 5:30 am start from Gainey Village.
evidence: Scottsdale Cycling's Strava event page lists the next ride for Sat Oct 3, 2026 at 5:30 am from 8977 N Scottsdale Rd, rated Intermediate / Rolling (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The event page shows the next date without a login.
